summary: Build practical energy baselines, ISO 50001-style controls, and savings dashboards in 5 days. Train with TrainingCred today.
lede: Energy management training helps energy, facilities and operations professionals measure performance and identify avoidable waste. Participants learn to analyze utility and interval data, establish energy baselines and performance indicators, and assess significant energy uses through audits. They also practice prioritizing operational improvements and tracking savings through monitoring plans and management reporting, using an ISO 50001-style continual-improvement approach.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage energy performance, operational efficiency, or sustainability reporting and need to produce measurable savings.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of facility operations, maintenance, utilities, or sustainability reporting is recommended. You should already understand basic electricity, fuel use, and operational cost drivers; no programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, energy bills, or meter data will help you move faster through the practical exercises. The course introduces advanced energy management concepts at an operational level and uses real-world templates, but it does not assume prior ISO 50001 implementation experience.
